choices.description: One entry per region you were given — all of them, none invented.

region.description: The region name, copied EXACTLY as it was given to you. It is the join key; a name that was not given cannot be matched to anything.

group.description: The group of this call, copied as given.

tag.description: The tag of the chosen molecule, copied EXACTLY from the group's molecule list — INCLUDING the group prefix, e.g. 'groupselectone--ml-card-selector'. The short name alone is refused. When no molecule of THIS group serves the region, answer the single word 'none' and say why in reason (if the right answer is a molecule of another group, say which).

scenarioUsed.description: The quick-reference scenario that led to the choice, copied exactly from the table, or the single word 'none' when no row applied.

reason.description: One or two sentences, in the user's language: what in the need decided this molecule over its siblings. If the catalog marks the chosen molecule as being outside the contract (no .defs.ts), say so here — a limitation the reader is not told about is a limitation they will hit.
